为.t: 甲骨文从「又」（手）从「象」，会以手牵象劳作之意（罗振玉说）。《说文》训「母猴也」，是未见甲骨文而致误。
为.tEn: The oracle-bone form combines 又 (a hand) and 象 (an elephant), interpreted as leading an elephant by hand to perform work (an interpretation attributed to Luo Zhenyu). The Shuowen defines it as "a female monkey," an error attributed here to the absence of oracle-bone evidence available to its author.

射.t: 甲骨文像手拉弓搭箭之形。《说文》析为「从矢从身」，于古文字无据。
射.tEn: The oracle-bone form depicts a hand drawing a bow with an arrow in place. The Shuowen analyzes it as combining 矢 (an arrow) and 身 (the body), but this analysis is not supported by the ancient written forms.

行.t: 甲骨文象四达之衢（十字路口）。《说文》训「人之步趨也」，非初义。
行.tEn: The oracle-bone form depicts roads extending in four directions: a crossroads. The Shuowen defines it as "a person walking and hurrying," which is not the original meaning.

出.t: 甲骨文从「止」（脚）从「凵」（穴居），会自穴居外出之意。《说文》谓「象艸木益滋，上出達也」，与初形不合。
出.tEn: The oracle-bone form combines 止 (a foot) and 凵 (a cave dwelling), expressing the idea of going out of a dwelling. The Shuowen says that it "depicts plants growing increasingly luxuriant and emerging upward," which does not match the earliest form.

各.t: 甲骨文从「夂」（脚）从「口」（穴居），会「到来」之意。《说文》训「異辭也」，是后起的假借义。
各.tEn: The oracle-bone form combines 夂 (a foot) and 口 (a cave dwelling), expressing the idea of arriving. The Shuowen defines it as "a word denoting difference," a later meaning acquired through phonetic borrowing.

止.t: 甲骨文象足趾之形，本义为脚。《说文》训「下基也，象艸木出有址」，非初形。
止.tEn: The oracle-bone form depicts toes; its original meaning was a foot. The Shuowen explains it as "the lower foundation, depicting the base from which plants grow," which does not match the earliest form.

得.t: 甲骨文从「彳」从「又」持「贝」，会获得之意。《说文》训「行有所得也」，义近而字形析解已变。
得.tEn: The oracle-bone form combines 彳 (a step) with 又 (a hand) holding 貝 (a cowrie shell), expressing the idea of obtaining something. The Shuowen defines it as "gaining something while traveling": the meaning is close, but the analysis of the form has changed.

家.t: 甲骨文从「宀」从「豕」，会屋下养豕之意。《说文》谓「豕省聲」，学者多以为非。
家.tEn: The oracle-bone form combines 宀 (a roof) and 豕 (a pig), expressing the idea of keeping a pig under a roof. The Shuowen says that a reduced form of 豕 indicates the pronunciation; many scholars disagree.

昔.t: 甲骨文从「日」从洪水形，谓往日（昔日）。《说文》训「乾肉也」，学者多以为非本义。
昔.tEn: The oracle-bone form combines 日 (the sun) with a form depicting floodwater, referring to former days or the past. The Shuowen defines it as "dried meat," which many scholars consider not to be the original meaning.

明.t: 甲骨文或从「日」从「月」，或从「囧」（窗）从「月」。《说文》谓「从月从囧」，与部分甲骨文形不合。
明.tEn: Oracle-bone forms combine either 日 (the sun) with 月 (the moon), or 囧 (a window) with 月. The Shuowen says that the character combines 月 and 囧, an analysis that does not match some of the oracle-bone forms.
